# Cyril Lisle

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>
- **Origin:** Portmaris  <sub>[v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v3 c25 P38](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0038)</sub>

## Appearance

Cyril is an attractive young man with expressive dark eyes. He is known for his handsome looks, polish, and a warm smile described as a velvet-like expression.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P40](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0040), [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c25 P48](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0048), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c38 P44](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0044), [v3 c38 P45](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0045)_

## Personality

He is smooth-talking, intelligent, and skilled at offering romantic compliments, though he can sometimes be perceived as lacking real substance or being persistent to the point of annoyance.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c38 P44](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0044), [v3 c38 P45](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0045)_

- Handsome  <sub>[v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c38 P44](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0044), [v3 c38 P45](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0045)</sub>
- Intelligent  <sub>[v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c38 P44](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0044)</sub>

## Abilities

- Charming courtship and offering poetic praise  <sub>[v3 c25 P42](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0042), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c38 P45](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0045)</sub>

## Goals

- To win Nell Harcourt as his wife  <sub>[v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c38 P36](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0036)</sub>
- To complete his Arts degree at Wexcombe  <sub>[v3 c25 P38](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0038)</sub>

## History

Cyril Lisle attended Wexcombe for his initial college years before spending two years traveling in Europe with his ill mother. Upon returning to complete his Arts degree as a Junior, he encountered Nell Harcourt during a sudden rainstorm in the park and rescued her with his umbrella. He subsequently sent her a dozen long-stemmed roses with a romantic poem and began courting her attentive to the point of assuming marriage. Later, his mother and sisters visited Tabby's Place to meet Nell. Ultimately, when he asked Nell to be his wife, she turned him down after realizing he did not fit into her life, leaving their relationship severed.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P38](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0038), [v3 c25 P41](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0041), [v3 c25 P42](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0042), [v3 c25 P44](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0044), [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c36 P22](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0022), [v3 c38 P36](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0036), [v3 c38 P41](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0041), [v3 c38 P45](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0045), [v3 c38 P49](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0049)_
